sponsored.t: Relates to extending provisions of laws permitting certain deductions from wages
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions of law relating to permitted deductions from wages for an additional two years.

sponsored.t: Revises the New York state veteran's memorial and monument registry
sponsored.sum: Revises the New York state veteran's memorial and monument registry such that it is easier to navigate; relates to the updating and availability of the registry.

sponsored.t: Enacts the student voter empowerment act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "student voter empowerment act"; requires each institution of higher education to designate a staff member to act as a student voting coordinator; requires such coordinator to develop and implement a student voting action plan to increase student voter registration and voting and democratic participation among students.

sponsored.t: Establishes the commercial tenant opportunity to purchase act
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Establishes the commercial tenant opportunity to purchase act; provides commercial tenants the right of first refusal for the purchase of certain commercial rental properties.

sponsored.t: Requires the state to participate in the United Nations for certain purposes
sponsored.sum: Requires the state to participate in the United Nations human rights council's universal periodic review by submitting a report in the capacity of a subnational stakeholder.

sponsored.t: Relates to the ability of government agencies in New York to claim copyright protection
sponsored.sum: Waives the ability of government agencies in New York to claim copyright protection except where the record reflects artistic, creative or scholarly works of authorship, academic course materials, or scientific or academic research, or if the copyright owner intends to distribute the record of derivative work based on it to the public by sale or other transfer of ownership.

sponsored.t: Creates a tax credit for certain animal expenses
sponsored.sum: Creates a tax credit for certain household pet expenses including medical and veterinary expenses and everyday expenses for up to two household pets.

sponsored.t: Relates to the maximum allowable timeframes to respond to requests for records under the freedom of information act
sponsored.sum: Relates to the maximum allowable timeframes to respond to requests for records under the freedom of information act.

sponsored.t: Imposes owner liability for failure of an operator to comply with traffic control indicators within the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Imposes owner liability for failure of an operator to comply with traffic control indicators within the city of New York through the use of traffic control indicator cameras.

sponsored.t: Relates to the interest rate cap on cash advances against wages or salary
sponsored.sum: Clarifies that all wage and cash advances against salary or future pay are loans subject to the interest rate cap in the general obligations law.

sponsored.t: Provides that all persons have the right to food and the right to be free from hunger, malnutrition, starvation and the endangerment of life from the scarcity of or lack of access to nourishing food
sponsored.sum: Provides that all persons have the right to grow, raise, harvest, produce and consume the food of their own choosing for their own nourishment, sustenance, bodily health and well-being, and the right to be free from hunger, malnutrition, starvation and the endangerment of life from the scarcity of or lack of access to nourishing food.

sponsored.t: Requires certain public schools in N.Y. city to offer Halal food options during lunch
sponsored.sum: Requires public schools in any city with a population over one million to offer Halal food options during lunch.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing notice to school districts and nonpublic schools located in N.Y. City of certain construction projects
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing notice to school districts and nonpublic schools located in New York city of certain construction projects; requires the New York city department of transportation to provide written notice to such school districts and nonpublic schools of certain construction projects undertaken within three hundred feet of a building of such school districts or nonpublic schools.

sponsored.t: Relates to the community air monitoring program
sponsored.sum: Requires that an assessment of the role that permit approvals for air contamination sources plays in contributing to stationary and mobile sources of air pollution be included in an addendum to the strategies for the development of community emission reduction programs; requires disclosure of last mile warehouse permits.

sponsored.t: Modernizes the access-a-ride program's application process
sponsored.sum: Modernizes the access-a-ride program's application process by creating an online application process and notifying applicants throughout the process via email.

sponsored.t: Prevents housing discrimination based on wage history, medical history, and health conditions
sponsored.sum: Prevents housing discrimination based on wage history, medical history, and health conditions.

sponsored.t: Allows for retail license for on-premises consumption to be granted to establishments located near a school, church, synagogue or other place of worship; repealer
sponsored.sum: Allows for retail license for on-premises consumption to be granted to establishments located on the same street or avenue and within two hundred feet of a building occupied exclusively as a school, church, synagogue or other place of worship.

sponsored.t: Relates to human trafficking awareness and training for public transportation employees
sponsored.sum: Relates to human trafficking awareness and training for public transit employees; mandates displaying human trafficking resource materials created by the state public transportation safety board and the department of transportation in all public transit modes of transportation.

sponsored.t: Ensures free speech on all college and university campuses within the state
sponsored.sum: Ensures free speech on all college and university campuses within the state; creates a cause of action for those who have their freedom of speech infringed upon by a college or university.

sponsored.t: Reduces the number of hours in a work week to thirty-two for employers with at least five hundred employees
sponsored.sum: Reduces the number of hours in a work week to thirty-two for employers with at least five hundred employees who are not part of a collective bargaining agreement.

sponsored.t: Relates to interest rate limitations for financing arrangements and the extension of credit
sponsored.sum: Provides interest rate limitations for financing arrangements and the extension of consumer credit; relates to the definitions of criminal usury in the first and second degrees; relates to the functions of the attorney general regarding rental purchase agreements.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York veteran digital navigator program act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York veteran digital navigator program act"; requires the state commissioner of the department of veterans' services to establish a program to promote digital citizenship, through which the state commissioner shall award grants to eligible entities.

sponsored.t: Provides grants for schoolyards and playgrounds; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Provides grants for schoolyards and playgrounds to become living schoolyards which provide outdoor learning spaces for students.

sponsored.t: Allows excelsior scholarship awards to be used for tuition and non-tuition expenses
sponsored.sum: Allows a certain portion of excelsior scholarship awards to be used for room and board expenses.

sponsored.t: Requires certain buildings display domestic violence signs in their bathrooms
sponsored.sum: Requires certain buildings display domestic violence signs developed by the office for the prevention of domestic violence in their bathrooms.

sponsored.t: Limits the time landlords have to process applications
sponsored.sum: Limits the time landlords have to process applications to seven days after which the application is deemed rejected.

sponsored.t: Designates October fifteenth as "Tadeusz Kosciuszko Day"
sponsored.sum: Designates October fifteenth of each year as "Tadeusz Kosciuszko Day".

sponsored.t: Requires the department of education create an online database of seats available for non-public and public institutions who offer college opportunity programs
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of education create an online database of seats available for non-public and public institutions who offer college opportunity programs and provide such information to authorized high school counselors.

sponsored.t: Requires local social services districts distribute shelter information specifically for lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, and gender non-conforming persons
sponsored.sum: Requires local social services districts distribute shelter information specifically for lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, and gender non-conforming persons on the district's website and as pamphlets at intake shelters.

sponsored.t: Directs the chief administrative judge of the New York unified court system to conduct a study on the office of court administration's housing court guardian ad litem program
sponsored.sum: Directs the chief administrative judge of the New York unified court system to conduct a study on the office of court administration's housing court guardian ad litem program and to publish a report on such study.

sponsored.t: Prohibits discrimination on the basis of a person's caste in opportunities of employment, housing, and access to public accommodations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits discrimination on the basis of a person's caste in opportunities of employment, housing, and access to public accommodations.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "sweatshop-free college apparel act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "sweatshop-free college apparel act" which requires institutions in the state of New York establish a sweat-free code of conduct in line with labor standards established by the Workers Right Consortium.

sponsored.t: Extends the metropolitan transportation authority's half fare rate program to persons receiving benefits from the supplemental nutrition assistance program
sponsored.sum: Extends the metropolitan transportation authority's half fare rate program to persons receiving benefits from the supplemental nutrition assistance program.

sponsored.t: Relates to the number of hours which constitute a work week
sponsored.sum: Lowers the hours which constitute a work week over three years to thirty-hours.

sponsored.t: Requires police officer training programs on interacting with individuals who are a part of a sexual orientation and/or gender minority
sponsored.sum: Requires police officer training programs on interacting with individuals who are a part of a sexual orientation and/or gender minority.

sponsored.t: Requires certain workers have access to paid sick leave
sponsored.sum: Requires employees have access to paid sick leave unless their employer demonstrates a certain set of conditions for their contract.

sponsored.t: Requires persons with housing vouchers be informed of their rights and provided with a bill of such rights
sponsored.sum: Requires persons with housing vouchers be informed of their rights and provided with a bill of such rights.

sponsored.t: Prevents discrimination based on wage history, medical history, and health conditions
sponsored.sum: Prevents housing discrimination based on wage history, medical history, and health conditions.

sponsored.t: Implements a New York resident discount at major sporting events
sponsored.sum: Implements a discount for New York residents at major sporting events held at publicly-funded venues.

sponsored.t: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage American shad
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage American shad until 12/31/2028.

sponsored.t: Relates to the maximum allowable timeframes to respond to requests for records under the freedom of information act
sponsored.sum: Relates to the maximum allowable time frames to respond to requests for records under the freedom of information act.

sponsored.t: Relates to student financial aid award letters
sponsored.sum: Requires student financial aid award letters to contain information on net costs, defined as an estimate of the costs of attendance after financial aid which does not require repayment and options for loans which do require repayment.
